item.title: MCP is a fad
item.description:
📝 This is the "NxM" problem. With a larger, disorganized toolset, they struggle. OpenAI recommends keeping tools well below 20, yet many MCP servers exceed this threshold.
🔗 Read more: https://tombedor.dev/mcp-is-a-fad/
